Personality

Rokuro is unique among the Serpos. Instead of allowing his duplicates to capture Momo, Rokuro made the choice to send them away as a truce for helping him turn them back to normal after being controlled by the Imotako Kur. He also demonstrated compassion. Following the battle with the Imotako Kur, Rokuro planned to use a needle he had stored within himself to heal Momo when the chance arose. However, during the Kur invasion, he decided to use the tool to treat Bamora's lethal injury caused by the Hastur Kur, helping both her and Momo who tried desperately to save her. While still affiliated with his duplicates, Rokuro was faithful and devoted to his kind, having chosen to collaborate with Momo and her companions to destroy the Serpo data the Kur had pilfered, even bequeathing this mission to Momo as his dying wish before his temporary demise. Following his banishment, Rokuro decides to use his independence to work for a living, but due to his poor pay, he's frequently shown to ask people in other occupations what their hourly wage is.
Synopsis

Kintama Hunt Saga

Space Globalists Arc

After the Kur's attack on the Serpos, Rokuro pursued the Imotako Kur to Moe Moe Kikoho in order to retrieve the technology the invaders stole and restore the Serpos to their original state after their data had been altered by the Kur to become obedient slaves. There, he rescues Momo from their assault and seeks her assistance in restoring his duplicates. After the Imotako Kur reveals himself to reclaim control over the Serpos, Rokuro directs Momo to defeat the alien using an attack based on her psychokinesis, since the foe is assaulting from another dimension and her supernatural powers can bypass the space. By the time Momo develops her Moe Moe Tri-Beam to defeat the Imotako Kur, Rokuro suffers severe damage from the onslaught of the altered Serpos. He then makes the choice to teleport the Serpos away from Momo just as they are about to capture her, calling it as a truce in gratitude for her help.

As Momo bandages her wounds, Rokuro gets her up to date of what he knows so far about the aliens who attacked his people and requests that she take him with her to check on her friends if they were also attacked by the Kur. Though she initially objects to taking him, Momo agrees in order to disguise herself and enter a Manga Cafe, as it is around the time she needed to hide from Reiko Kashima. During their stay, Rokuro pulls out an extendable needle from his abdomen to pierce Momo with but quickly retracts it back after she wakes up from the front desk man knocking on the door to check on them. Rokuro and Momo then resume their disguise after the employee enters. However, Rokuro almost gives them away after giving the employee permission to check to see his panties and his second dress shirt. Momo then employs her psychic abilities to entangle her arm bandage around the mirror held by the employee, discerning his possession by Reiko Kashima. Once the possession is lifted and the employee dashes away apologizing for his abrupt incivility to a customer, Momo reprimands Rokuro for his antics and questions the retractable needle on his chest. In response, Rokuro deflects by inquiring whether Momo has ever been the object of a confession, irritating her further.

Later, Rokuro is taken by Momo to her house. While outside, Rokuro witnesses Momo driving Bamora away after she accuses the girl of being in league with the enemy. He then inquires why Momo is crying after driving an enemy away, only to be told by Momo that she isn't crying. This leads him to comment on his inability to understand Earthlings, a sentiment Momo concurs with. After Momo states her intentions to find the Kur and avenge her injured friends, Rokuro informs her that the base of their enemies would have to be at a nearby pyramid-level transmission system, thus a Kofun burial mound. Later, he convenes with Aira, Jiji, and Mr. Mantis Shrimp, where Momo informs him that the Kur have seized Okarun's kintama. This reinforces his suspicion that they are space globalists plotting to invade Earth by using Okarun's kintama to energize their warp gate and summon their main force. Upon deducing that the main force would arrive in roughly five days, Rokuro shares his ideas on locating the Kur before time runs out. However, he expresses doubts about their ability to defeat them, which Momo contests. He then becomes shocked to learn that the group has met Ludris after hearing Momo's conversation with Mr. Mantis Shrimp about borrowing his ship to pick up her grandmother and is prompted to reveal the alien's celebrated identity. With the group deciding that their next course of action should be to get stronger through training, Rokuro recommends that they move elsewhere to avoid being targeting again and suggests the region of Nagi Hospital.

After finishing their training, the group sets out for the location where the exosuit aliens are gearing up to summon their main force. Upon arrival, Rokuro notices that the enemy's warp gate is already active, with small ships having passed through it. As they come under attack from the exosuit aliens, Momo leads Rokuro to shut down the warp gate as instructed, while Aira, Jiji, and Mr. Mantis Shrimp engage in combat with their adversaries. En route, the pair is intercepted by two exosuit aliens. Rokuro employs his psychokinesis to form a shield, protecting Momo from the barrage of bullets unleashed by the mecha exosuit alien, and requests for her to swiftly defeat them before his shield fails. After the shield collapses, Bamora makes a sudden appearance to attack the exosuit aliens but ends up mortally injured by the Spatial Exosuit Alien. Rokuro erects another barrier to shield Momo from the Jet Booster Exosuit Alien while she frantically tries to use her powers to heal Bamora. With his strength weakening and Momo becoming too prioritized in healing Bamora to concentrate on defeating the Jet Booster Exosuit Alien trying to breach the shield, Rokuro is forced to resort to using his needle appendage — originally intended for Momo if she were mortally wounded — to treat Bamora's wound and save her life. Rokuro then makes his final plea to Momo, asking her to erase the Serpo data stolen by the exosuit aliens by destroying their suits, before he lowers his shield and succumbs to his injuries.

Unbeknownst to Momo and the others, Rokuro managed to be saved by Mr. Mantis Shrimp using the nanoskin to reconstruct the missing parts to his body. Following the invasion ending with Reiko Kashima destroying the invading fleet, Rokuro visits the Ayase residence to express his thanks to Momo for fulfilling her promise to destroy the Serpo data from the exosuit aliens. He then becomes prompted to make an immediate departure following Momo's insistence that he rid himself of any intentions of further aggression towards her and her allies.

Danmara Arc

Eventually, Rokuro went back to the Serpos, only to be banished by his clones due to his association with the Family leading to a divergence in mentality. Rokuro then went on to acquire a part-time job at a convenience store.

While working a shift, Rokuro encounters Momo and Okarun as they come into the convenience store looking to buy a maneki-neko doll. After he explains to them his situation with the Serpos, Rokuro is enlisted Momo's help to hack into the Kamikoshi Police Box's computer and find out who claimed Okarun's second kintama. Though he agrees to help her and was fortunate enough to have an employee cover his shift, Rokuro demands for Momo to take responsibility if he were to lose his job. At the police box, Rokuro uses his nanoskin to disguise himself as a police officer and enters to look into the computer files. However, after Bega returns from patrol, he unexpectedly encounters him at the door and engages in a fight against him. To resolve their dispute, Rokuro fabricates a tale about being a fellow police officer named Tanaka, dispatched to the police box to inspect the lost property records and that he could not help himself but to start a fight with with him given his reputation. As Bega uses his phone to call the police box and verify Rokuro's claim, Rokuro discreetly uses his nanoskin to tap into Bega's phone and act as the voice of the police officer confirming his assignment. After this works to convince Bega, Rokuro manages to acquire the information on who claimed Okarun's second kintama and informs Momo and Okarun that the person is Unji Zuma of Renjaku High School.

Later, as Bega chases down Okarun and Rin for being out passed curfew, Rokuro becomes prompted to follow them in hopes that they can help him get a lead on a new part-time job. This action then leads him to entering the inner world of the cursed trunk, along with Okarun, Turbo Granny, and Bega. After catching up with Okarun, Rokuro uses his nanoskin to construct a convenience store counter as a way to shield Okarun from a shockwave blast fired by Umbrella Boy Unji. He and Bega then engage Umbrella Boy Unji in battle with their weapons. Okarun also offers assistance, proposing that Rokuro build a jetpack to combat Umbrella Boy Unji mid-flight. However, this plan ends up failing due to Umbrella Boy Unji being shrouded by the air currents, thwarting Rokuro's attempt to get near him. Rokuro then proceeds to execute Okarun's second request to construct a large heater to warm the air, with the plan being to generate a tornado to force Umbrella Boy Unji to the ground where they can fight him up close. After Okarun retrieves his kintama from Umbrella Boy Unji, activating Turbo Granny's power to combat the possessed youth, Rokuro assists by employing his psychokinesis to levitate debris, creating footholds for Okarun to reach Umbrella Boy Unji mid-air.

While everyone trapped inside the cursed trunk gather together, Rokuro becomes pre-occupied with trying to find a good paying part-time job. Eventually, he and the others find themselves being lifted up the air by Rin, from the other side, using Mai's Onbusuman gravity powers to bring the captives out of the cursed trunk. In response to the unexpected event, Rokuro clings to Okarun's leg, while Bega grips onto his. In this instant, Rokuro catches Okarun's confession to Momo and queries about the emotion Okarun is experiencing at the time. Rokuro, Okarun, and Bega ascend after Momo has Okarun let go of her hand, urging him to defeat the Fairy-Tale Card so she can break free from the cursed trunk. While being lifted up in the air, Rokuro voices his worries about the store manager being angry with him if he does not return to his post. He, Okarun, and Bega then plummet after Rin's gravitational song is ceased by the Fairy-Tale Card. Utilizing his nanoskin, Rokuro creates a jetpack to stay airborne while being forced to carry Okarun and Bega as they cling to his legs. This prompts him to request that they let go since the additional weight hinders his ascent.

Rokuro manages to fly out him, Okarun, and Bega out of the cursed trunk and back into the real world where Count Saint-Germain is currently battling the Fairy-Tale Card. While fleeing from the Fairy-Tale Cards tendrils targeting them, Rokuro recognizes the eyeless man talking to Okarun as Count Saint-Germain and inquires why he is here. After Count Saint-Germain tells Rokuro that he cannot explain his reason at the moment, Rokuro uses his particle beam to destroy one of the Fairy-Tale Cards' cards, only to see it regenerate from one of his bulbs. This leads to Count Saint-Germain explaining to him and Okarun the yokai's weakness; that they must destroy all cards simultaneously to prevent him from regenerating. To achieve this, Rokuro is instructed by Count Saint-Germain to aim his beam at the eye card upon receiving his signal, while he and Okarun focus on destroying the remaining cards. Rokuro then inquiries about the hourly rate for the task, to which the man responds that he will consider it later. With Unji also helping using his Umbrella Boy shockwave blast, the four manage to defeat the Fairy-Tale Card.

Abilities and Powers

Extraterrestrial Abilities

Rokuro possesses the same base technology and base abilities like any other Serpo.

Equipment

Nanoskin [v · e]
Rokuro's nanoskin
Rokuro acquired Ludris' nanoskin via Mr. Mantis Shrimp as a lifesaving measure amidst the climax of the Kur invasion. As a result, Rokuro gained the ability to shape his nanoskin body extensions into a variety of forms.
Usage
Rokuro particle beam
Rokuro is able to use his nanoskin for infiltration by altering it into clothing for quick disguises and employing it to hack into technological devices to retrieve information, like data from a computer. However, due to the limited quantity of nanoskin, Rokuro cannot create a mask to fully complete his disguise. In his confrontation against Umbrella Boy Unji, Rokuro formed a convenience store counter that can fire a particle beam from its scanner, offering him protection against his enemy's shockwave attacks while he counterattacked, and constructed jet propellers on his back and arms. He also employed his nanoskin as part of Okarun's strategy to bring the airborne Umbrella Boy Unji to the ground, creating a large heater powered by their combined running in an effort to generate a whirlwind that would draw him in.

The Serpo Aliens (セルポ星人, Serupo Seijin?, Viz: Serpoian) are an entirely male alien race who come from Planet Serpo in the Zeta Reticuli system.

In Dandadan, they serve as secondary antagonists during the Turbo Granny Arc and primary antagonists during the Serpo Arc. While serving as minor antagonists during the first part of the Space Globalists Arc.

Overview

Due to their race being exclusively all male, the Serpo have no way of reproducing naturally and resort to using cloning technology. However, since biological evolution cannot occur within identical beings, the Serpo found this solution to be ineffective and realizing the stagnation this had caused in their race seek to gain reproductive organs by abducting humans from Earth and stealing their reproductive organs (aka "bananas"). And later on become highly fascinated in spiritual powers and seek to harness their capabilities to progress their evolution.
Physical Characteristics

The Serpo are often seen sporting grey-skinned, outwardly male humanoid disguises. These disguises share a common outfit consisting of white, collared button up shirts tucked into grey dress pants, leather belts, and brown shoes. The heads of the disguises are notable for their thin lips which are drawn into incredibly wide and disconcerting smiles.

Out of their disguises, the Serpo have angular, slug-like heads with large, prominent lips and broad teeth. Their bodies are broad and sharply angled around the shoulders and torso. Black markings cover most of their bodies. They have two fingers and two thumbs in each hand, and their feet are clefted at the ends. Serpo also possess a set of headlight-like crystalline eyes whose color varies between individual Serpo, such as pink, yellow, cyan, red, green, or purple.
Gallery

A Serpo while in disguise.
A Serpo outside of his disguise.
A Serpo outside of his disguise.
Psychological Characteristics

The Serpo are forceful and violent towards humans when abducting them but are otherwise oblivious to this, believing that their actions are peaceful. They also prefer to abduct female humans over male humans and have stated that they despise encountering humans that act barbaric (i.e. those who fight back). Another interest they have are the supernatural abilities of humans who have gained powers from spirits, since those powers often surpass the capabilities of the Serpo's already highly advanced technologies.

Other than being obliviously hostile towards humans, the Serpo are brunt and cold towards their subordinates, having no concern for their hired help's well-being and viewing them as nothing but cheap and easily replaceable. While the Dover Demon took on the task of fighting Momo, Okarun and Aira, the Serpo attempted to spur him during his poor performance by deducting his salary and injecting him with a mutagenic fluid meant to give him increased speed and strength (in spite of his objections).
Biology

As manufactured clones, the Serpos have artificial bodies that are predominantly mechanical yet partially organic, evidenced by their ability to bleed. They are capable of surviving otherwise grievous bodily harm including the loss of their limbs and their entire lower halves.
Internal Tools

The mechanical bodies of the Serpos are installed with various tools that are stored within their groin and abdomen:

Reproductive Tool
A mechanical appendage with a retractable needle used for purpose of extracting reproductive organs (referred to as "banana organs") from female humans through sexual intercourse. The cable can also be used to increase the power of an alien.
Serpo Reproductive Tool
Scissors
A single large pair of scissors that are used for to extract the genitalia of male humans.
Scissor Tool (Anime)
Body Cables
Two cables with needles that are capable of fusing a Serpo's body with one or more lifeforms.
Amalgamation Cables (Anime)
Data

The Serpo This Man Version
Serpos who have turned into This Man.
The creation of a Serpo that is identical in appearance and behaves similarly to the rest requires the input of a specific set of data. In the event their data is overwritten at the time of their birth, a Serpo will take on a different form called This Man (ディス マン, Disu Man?). This form resembles a semi-bald man with large eyebrows wearing a zipper sweatshirt and baggy sweatpants. A Serpo's execution of their psychokinesis is altered as well; clapping their hands together instead of thrusting their hand foward or forming the letter T.

Abilities and Powers

Super-Intelligence: The Serpo are incredibly intelligent, possessing advanced skills in science and technology. With their advanced technology, they are able to create clones of themselves, construct tools within their bodies, build UFOs, and construct the devices needed to cast Empty Space.

Psychokinesis [v · e]
Serpo's Psychokinesis
The Serpo possess psychic powers, allowing them to manipulate objects and people, exert shockwaves, create psychic fields, and manipulate brainwaves, which is used to induce a state of physical arousal in abducted humans when preparing to extract their reproductive organs.

By combining their psychokinetic powers together, the Serpo are able to create a pressurize field that is able to nullify and subdue a human with yokai powers.
Synopsis

Past

In the 1960's and 1970's, with the support of aliens that had survived the Roswell Incident, the United States military sent twelve people on a study exchange to the Planet Serpo. Of the twelve, two died on Planet Serpo and another eight returned to Earth but eventually died due to the powerful ultraviolet radiation they were exposed to on the alien's world. The remaining two opted to stay on Serpo; their fates are unknown.

Turbo Granny Arc

At Nagi Hospital, the Serpo encounter Momo Ayase and forcibly abduct her to extract her reproductive organs. Before they could begin their procedure, a possessed Okarun unexpectedly appears out of Momo's phone and attacks the aliens. After managing to subdue him with their psychic powers, the Serpo proceed with the procedure on Momo. However, after overstimulating her brainwaves, the Serpo accidently unlock Momo's psychic powers and are defeated after the girl destroys their ship.

Serpo Arc

Episode 8-6
The Serpo targets Okarun for his powers.
Intrigued by what they saw from Okarun while he was possessed by Turbo Granny, the Serpo, along with the Dover Demon and Nessie as subordinates, locate and confront him at his school with the intention of taking his supernatural abilities for themselves. They are met with unexpected interference from Aira Shiratori, a spiritually aware human girl wielding Acrobatic Silky's abilities. The Serpo have the Dover Demon fight back against her and use their combined psychokinesis to subdue both Okarun and Aira. However, the Serpo are shocked when Momo arrives and overrides their psychic powers with her own, allowing Okarun and Aira to continue fighting them. To gain the upper hand, the Serpo forcefully mutate the Dover Demon but are disappointed to see that it is fighting poorly against Okarun and Aira's coordinated attacks. The Serpo then find themselves attacked by Nessie, in spite of their hiring it specifically to fend off Momo. One Serpo is quickly bisected while chastising Nessie for failing to keep Momo occupied, and another is decapitated shortly thereafter to the horror of the Dover Demon.

SDDN's High-Compression Water Blast (Anime)
The Serpo Dover Demon Nessie attacks Momo, Okarun, and Aira.
With only one member left alive, the Serpo uses his Amalgamation Cables to merge himself with Nessie and the Dover Demon to eliminate Okarun, Momo, and Aira. The Serpo Dover Demon Nessie attacks them with high-compression water blasts from its mouth but soon runs out of water after the three managed to evade his beams. After absorbing the water from his neck to reload, Okarun, Momo, and Aira realized that the Serpo Dover Demon Nessie can't fire the blasts continuously and believes that attacking his neck will cease his assaults. Aira uses her hair to restrict the Serpo Dover Demon Nessie's neck and moves to strike it. However, the fused alien intercepts her with a punch, stating that, despite his appearance, he is a close-combat fighter due to having the Dover Demon's mantis shrimp arms.

Okarun defeats SDDN (Anime)
The Serpo Dover Demon Nessie defeated by Okarun.
Viewing Momo as dangerous, the Serpo Dover Demon Nessie confronts her with the intent to beat her to death and dissect her body later. However, before he could land his attacks, Momo uses her psychic powers to force back the surrounding water, causing the Serpo Dover Demon Nessie's arms to shatter under the stress of throwing full-force punches without being underwater. The fused alien then catches Momo by his teeth, first trying to bite down on her then simply holding her in place in hopes that she will eventually drown. During this time, he begins to charge another high-compression water blast meant to bisect her. However, the Serpo Dover Demon Nessie finds his neck caught by Aira's hair once again and panics as Okarun uses it as a runway to launch himself through its body, obliterating it.

Trivia

The body design for the Serpo greatly resembles the Dada race from the Ultraman series.
Certain parts of their body are based on another race of aliens called Alien Pegassa.
The position of the Serpo's arms when using the Serpo Formula Surveying Method is a reference to the pose struck by Ultraman when using his Ultra Beam.
The name Serpo in relation to extraterrestrial entities is prominent in Ufology, sometimes as a government project, other times as the homeworld of an alien race.
The Serpo's disguised face coincidentally resembles former Thai prime minister Thaksin Shinawatra and become viral meme edited by among Thai fans.

The Kur (深淵クの者ル, Kuru?), a term dubbed by the Serpo, refers to a militaristic alien race who originate from the farthest reaches of space. Described as globalists (グローバリスト, gurōbarisuto?), they have been actively seeking out planets within the galactic system to conquer.

In Dandadan, they serve as the main antagonistic group during the Space Globalists Arc.

Overview

Biology

Takonoka Ru Patcho Kur's appearance
The Kur outside their exosuits.
The Kur are octopus-like in appearance with a set of tentacles for a mouth. They also vary in size.

The Kur, resembling the soft-bodied octopus, are incapable of surviving in a planet's atmosphere for long without the support of a exosuit. Though they can function normally when exposed to the atmosphere for a short period of time, it is unknown as to what their limit is until they die, however, it is evident to be less than a day, as the Kur Okarun defeated died sometime between the evening of when they fought and the morning the next day Momo came home to find her friends injured and the dead Kur in one of the beds laid out by Mr. Mantis Shrimp.

Advance Unit

The Advance Unit (先行部隊, Senkō Butai?) were a group of ten Kur members whose role was to track down and eliminate Bamora and summon their main force to Earth as their next conquest. Their search for the female Sumerian led to them defeating the Serpo, Okarun, Aira, and Jiji, with the former two being robbed of their data and technology and the single kintama to power up their gate that would summon the main force to invade Earth. Following the gate being opened, the Advance Unit was defeated by Momo and her allies.

Inter-species Relationships

Big Mama being fed
The Kur feeding Sumerians to a Big Mama to make exosuits.
As invaders, the Kur are hostile, violent, and ruthless towards other races. From their perspective, the species of the planets they take over are primarily seen as being "material" for the creation of exosuits for them to wear and enjoy when utilized on the battlefield. Lifeforms who possess great capabilities are seen by the Kur as having the potential to become extraordinary exosuits that is highly valued. Additionally, the Kur make use of the possession's lifeforms leave behind if they can be of any benefit to them and may also choose to enslave them to do their bidding, as the Serpos were altered by a Kur to act as their minions against Momo.

Despite this, the Kur are opened to welcoming strong individuals into their group, with Count Saint-Germain being an example of a non-Kur member. The operator of a jet booster exosuit within the Advance Unit also appears to be a humanoid alien much like Count Saint-Germain.
Military Strength

The Kur's military might has proven to be immense, with their invasion of Sumer nearly bringing the Sumerians to the brink of extinction, and though the war dragged on with the resistance, they still maintained the upper hand. Even with only a few members being sent to Earth as their next planet to dominate, the Kur were formidable enough to decisively crush the Serpo and steal their advanced technology for themselves, increasing their power. They were also too overwhelming for humans who possess some sort of supernatural ability, yet after training to get stronger were able to overcome the Advanced Unit, albeit barely. Had it not been for Reiko Kashima's involvement in annihilating the main force, the Kur's invasion of Earth would have most likely led to their victory, as Rokuro made it clear to Momo and her allies that there would be nothing they could do once the entire army assembled. Especially when the estimated the total number of the main force were at least a million. The Kur also formed an alliance with the mysterious Count Saint-Germain, making them an even bigger threat than what they have shown capable of, as they likely have access to spiritual relics and other materials, prompting the Serpo to alert the other worlds of the Kur's existence and activity as they are continuing to devour worlds and strip them of all resources and life for themselves.

Battle Suits
The Kur in their various exosuits.
The Kur wear exosuits that are manufactured from bioengineered Big Mamas by feeding them natives to the planet they had taken over as nourishment malleable material. While they primarily serve as a safety garment to help keep them alive in the atmosphere of foreign planets due to their soft and fragile bodies, yet they further act as advanced weaponry for warfare, possessing highly advanced combat capabilities, such as manipulating space and forming an orb of vibration around the wearer, alongside being armed with numerous advanced alien weaponries. The stolen technological resources from the Serpo have also boasted their military power, but it’s hard to say if the Serpo’s technology has been delivered to the rest of the Kur empire or not.
Spaceships

Main Force

Main Force
The Main Force.
The Kur possessed a main force (本隊, hontai?) comprising of a fleet of spacecrafts, with the most prominent ship in the fleet being a large battleship. These spaceships were used during the invasion of Sumer where they laid waste to the land. After arriving on Earth, the Advance Unit summoned a gate within an Empty Space, using Okarun's kintama as a battery, that allowed smaller spaceships from the main force to pass through one by one until the entire fleet arrived, which was successfully done before the gate was closed by Okarun. Though the fleet nearly came close to initiating their invasion of Earth by disrupting Empty Space with their launched attack, Reiko Kashima used her powers to destroy the main ship and eliminate the main force after trapping them inside her mirror.

However despite Rokoro clarifying the Kur’s military are structured in small numbers, it is likely their fleets and overall forces are far more vast than the Main Force sent to invade Sumer and Earth, as the Serpo note that several worlds are continuing to be consumed by the Kur.

Synopsis

Kaiju Arc

Three Serpo clones notice an unknown presence in their base and warn the intruder that the building is their territory. Suddenly, two of the clones get crushed with an advanced technology and the last clone gets grabbed by an alien, who points out that his things are his things, but the serpo's also belong to him.

Jiji enters Bamora's Kaiju and accidentally sends out a signal which the same alien picks up, standing on top of Serpo's corpses and surrounded by mysterious beings who supposedly belong to his group.

Space Globalists Arc

As the group returns home from school, Jiji and Aira are catapulted into Empty Space and they get approached by the Suda Ko Kur, the Takonoka Ru Patcho Kur and the Ta Komeshi Kur. The three open fire and try to defeat the two teenagers, utilizing their powerful exosuits which are able to even defeat Evil Eye after Aira splashed water on Jiji to receive the yokai's aid. They are brutally beat and the Takonoka Ru Patcho Kur slithers out of his suit, revealing his true form similar to Earth's octopi, but Shiratori envelops themselves in a hair ball to escape. The three aliens try to use life-sign detection, but the planet is covered by mysterious white orbs which block their view. They have to leave and the two humans escape safely, who need to warn the others about possible attacks.

At the same time, Okarun gets attacked by the Jet Booster Exosuit Kur, the Ta Koshin Jo Kur, the Head Exosuit Kur, the Ta Kowasa Kur, the Mantis Exosuit Kur and the Hastur Kur. He activates Turbo Granny's powers but he stands no chance against them, even by going all out. Defeated, they utilize a serpoian apparatus, stolen from their base, to extract his Kintama. They kidnap him to study his internal workings, although he's saved by Mr. Mantis Shrimp and the aliens leave due to them running out of time.

Momo finishes her shift at the Moe Moe Kikoho and prepares to leave, but the door is locked. She turns around to see the maid cafe's costumers reveal themselves as clones. She tries to defend herself but their sheer quantity is too much for her. They immobilize her and pull out another serpoian apparatus to extract her genitals, when suddenly a Serpo appears and rescues her, demanding the object. He explains to her how they'll have to crush the clones with two irons and they cooperate, being able to convert one of the enemy clones into a Serpo. A clash between the two parties intensifies while Momo discovers the Imotako Kur on the ceiling, piercing the Serpos and turning them on his side. She tries to damage him, but attacks pass through him as Rokuro points out that he's attacking from another dimension. On the point of defeat, Momo remembers Seiko using the power of words on her bat to give a stronger blow. Recalling the ritual she performs as a maid, she uses her psychic powers to emit a Moe Moe Tri-Beam. The attack passes through dimensions and annihilates the alien, freeing the clones from its control. Rokuro makes a truce with Momo for helping him recollect his stolen merchandise.

Back at the Ayase Residence, Mr. Mantis Shrimp treats the injured kids and the Head Exosuit Kur, though he unfortunately died of injuries given to him by Okarun during the ambush. Momo scavenges the Head Exosuit and discovers the ball which powers it, identical to Bamora's. This leads to Ayase kicking her out of the house believing she's a spy which informed the aliens about their positions and powers. Rokuro reveals to the Family that the aliens are globalists from outer space and they are trying to invade the Earth. They are few in numbers, but their exosuits make up for it. The aliens who attacked them are an Advance Unit, who will need lots of energy to call in their main force. Thanks to the data they stole from the Serpo, they found out about the Family's powers which would prove as a strong battery for the warp. Despite only stealing Okarun's ball, they could still attempt to steal and use the teens' yokais to power it. Rokuro approximates their arrival to be in five days, so they must get the kintama back before the main fleet arrives.

Momo, Jiji, Aira and Mr. Mantis Shrimp take shelter in the abandoned Serpo's base, where they activate combat-use simulators to train against holograms of the Kur that ambushed them.

The Family gets blown up inside the Ayase Residence car by the aliens on the day of the Kur Invasion. Jiji, Aira and the Dover Demon fight against the aliens while Momo and Rokuro search for the Kintama. The trio seems to lose at first, but thanks to Jiji's "Evil Gun", they gain back momentum, defeating the Ta Kowasa Kur who slithers out of the broken exosuit. Meanwhile, the duo gets stopped by the Ta Koshin Jo Kur and the Jet Booster Exosuit Kur but Bamora suddenly joins the fight in her Kaiju and defeats the former. The leader of the Advance Unit, the Hastur Kur, arrives and help defeat Bamora, executing her. Momo tries to save her but she taps into her aura, having her and the Family watch her life on the planet Sumer, victim to an invasion caused by the same aliens.

Bamora grew up with Banga, Aja and Tome, fighting the octopi every day. In a forest, their battalion discovers a Big Mama who was eating Sumerian soldiers to produce exosuits for the invaders' species. Later, they are lured in an empty field to find the other remaining battalion, but they are decimated by the Kur forces, leaving only the four alive. They decide to trust an old sumerian myth about a warp gate inside the Pyramid, which the aliens use as base to make offerings to Big Mama. Bamora tries to free the enslaved men but fails, almost dooming her squad. An injured Banga discovers and enters the God of Sumer exosuit, inciting the men to take back their planet from the invaders. During the huge chaos, they discover the warp gate has energy for only one person, so her stepmother pushes Bamora inside it, sending her to Earth. The Advance Unit appears behind her, promising to chase the girl throughout the universe and killing her because she stole their exosuit. They demand Banga to use the Sumerian slab and begin torturing Aja to force her.

Rokuro uses his apparatus to cure Bamora and dies, which makes the shield around them collapse and the fight begins again. Okarun finally enters empty space and reveals the power of the spiral to the trio. With an honed "Evil Gun" and a "Pirouette, Noble Drill", they defeat the members of the Advance Unit. However, more ships pass through the warp gate, giving support to the Hastur Kur and the Jet Booster Kur and they easily crush Momo. She's saved by Okarun's spiral powers and the arrival of the Family, with Jiji turned into Evil Eye, signs the start of the final battle. Ayase notices how the Hastur stores its carved out space into its back which acts as a different dimension. Utilizing her powers and with the aid of Okarun, the two defeat the Leader of the Advance Unit. Still, the Hastur Kur survives and takes over the Bamora's exosuit, throwing her in the void. Kinta, who read the note meant for Seiko, reached the Family with its nanoskin motorbike and flies towards her, forming the Great Kinta. The two titans clash and Kinta comes out on top, copying the same power bomb attacked which Aira and Momo used to defeat Bamora's exosuit.

Although they defeated all the invaders, the warp gate opens completely and the main fleet arrives. The massive destruction it causes begins to tear apart Empty Space, and at the same time, Reiko Kashima enters it and is delighted to finally get her revenge on Momo. Reiko notices the attacks of the Kur and she's reminded of her tragic death during the war. She takes out her mirror and begins punching it, replicating it on every single shard inside the city and the ships. This completely annihilates the Kur's fleet and traps their remains inside her mirror. After Reiko Kashima recognizes the romance between Okarun and Momo, she leaves, while empty space finally closes and returns everything back to normal.

The Serpo begin scanning the data inside the Hastur, discovering that they come from deep space and invade every planet in their way. They define their species as "Kur", the people of the depths. However, they discover that the mysterious and notorious Count Saint-Germain collaborated with them in some way.

Kozuka Knives Arc

At some point after the invasion, the wielder of the Jet Booster Exosuit awakens to find herself out of her suit in a ruined area. Spotting Count Saint-Germain standing before her after he speaks, she instinctively adopts a defensive stance. The man gestures towards her damaged exosuit beside her, suggesting that if it is indeed hers, she will need a replacement as it is no longer fully operational. Curious about his intentions, she asks what he wants from her. Count Saint-Germain explains that he requires her assistance for a certain issue and reassures her that she has the right to refuse. However, he highlights that rejecting his offer and permitting him to leave would compel her to face the challenges of Earth's heavy gravity on her own, a reality that becomes apparent as he notices her difficulty in remaining upright while they speak. With this said, the alien is asked by him if she is willingly to let him help her.

Trivia

The name Kur is a name for the Mesopotamian underworld in the Sumerian language. The direct translation for the word is "Ground" when used to refer to the Underworld.
The physical form of the Kur outside their suits may well be a reference to Cthulhu, the extraterrestrial diety created by H. P. Lovecraft. They may also be a reference to the Martians from H.G. Wells War of the Worlds, cause their octopus like appearance are similar to how the book describes them with the Hastur Kur being more closer to what a War of the Worlds Martians would look like.

The Ta Komeshi Kur was a Kur of the Advance Unit who wielded the Ta Komeshi.

In Dandadan, he serves as a major antagonist during the Space Globalists Arc.

Appearance

The Kur has never been seen outside of his Ta Komeshi exosuit. Nonetheless, being a Kur, he is presumed to share the octopus-like physiology characteristic of his species.
Personality

Like many other Kurs, he has a grand sense of superiority. He's also really confident in his abilities as he laid claim on the future exosuit made up of Jiji's chi while chatting with the Suda Ko Kur.
Background

The Ta Komeshi Kur took part in the invasion of Sumer. Years later, he and his team caught Banga using the Sumerian pyramid to transport Bamora to Earth in the midst of a rebellion between the enslaved male Sumerians and the Kur.
Synopsis

Kintama Hunt Saga

Space Globalists Arc

While Jiji and Aira walk together back home, they are suddenly transported in Empty Space and are approached by the Ta Komeshi Kur together with the Takonoka Ru Patcho Kur and the Suda Ko Kur. They overwhelm the power users, even when Jiji transforms into Evil Eye, who refuses to fight due to the promise he made to Takakura. The duo manages to escape them as the life-sign detection in the exosuits' HUD is cluttered by mysterious orbs present only on Earth.

At the start of the Kur Invasion, he traps Aira with his mechanical cylinders and activates his shockwave field. Jiji tries freeing her by sending out chi with no avail. Being the last member still standing on the battleground, he struggles with coming up with a name for his special move, but then emits the Evil Gun towards the Ta Komeshi Kur, disintegrating the left side of his exosuit along with three mechanical arms. The Ta Kowasa Kur ambushes Jiji and begins absorbing his powers. The overwhelming power blows his exosuit, so the other three open fire simultaneously on Jiji, which he blocks with another Evil Gun projectile. He cooperates with the Suda Ko Kur to eliminate Jiji while the Takonoka Ru Patcho Kur takes care of Aira.

He appears during the invasion of Sumer and partecipates in a giant ambush against the last Sumerian battalion, decimating their forces. Later he's seen guarding the hundreds of Sumerian men who are being fed to Big Mama in front of the Pyramid. Bamora, Banga, Tome and Aja try to free them but the rescue attempt fails due to their lack of cooperation. Tome gets crushed by the Ta Komeshi Kur's shockwave field but she's saved by the sumerian men who rebelled thanks to Banga's speech. Bamora escapes to Idea by using the Warp Gate so he, along with other members of the Advance Unit, catch Banga inside the Pyramid and begin torturing Aja to have her activate the inner mechanism of the royal slab.

Jiji gets injured but manages to get up and surprise the aliens with a third Evil Gun shot. Him and the Suda Ko Kur counter the attack with beams of their own. They are amazed by the boy's strength and begin laying claim on the powerful exosuit he will be converted into. Okarun finally enters Empty Space and contacts his two friends to tell them about the power of the spiral. Jiji recalls a conversation he had with Seiko about a spinning top which remains standing thanks to the spiral power, which he should replicate by merging his chi with Evil Eye's and spinning it. The Evil Gun gets honed, causing the two aliens to tremble in fear before they get overwhelmed by its immensive destructive power.

Unji Zuma (頭ず間ま雲うん児じ, Zuma Unji?) is a student at Renjaku High School who is the leader of a gang of outcasts from other high schools. After acquiring Okarun's kintama from a mysterious person, Unji puts himself up to the task of beating the diorama board game Danmara.

Appearance

Unji is a tall young man with short-cropped hair, the sides of which are shaven, with two horizontal yellow stripes and has a chin stubble. He has a left eyebrow piercing and stud earrings. He wears a dark long sleeve t-shirt underneath a long sleeve collar shirt with a white spot pattern and dark pants with a belt. He also wears geta sandals as his main preference for footwear.

As a child, Unji's hair was already shaved, and his outfit consisted of a simple long sleeve shirt and pants. After being orphaned, Unji gained black rings around his eyes that stuck with him for most of his life.

In his early adolescences, Unji grew his hair to have it in an undercut style, which was pushed back, and was light in color (most likely dyed). His eyebrows were missing, and by this time, he had already gained his piercings and had a small cut located on his left chin. He wore a coat on top of a dark shirt and tracksuit pants. After being released from juvenile detention, Unji's hair returns to its original hairstyle and his eyebrows have grown back. He wore a dark jacket, with an undershirt, pants, and shoes.

After leaving the hospital following escaping the Danmara trunk, Unji's hair has grown out somewhat scruffily, with a slight part in the centre. He has also opted to wear glasses as the treats that shrunk Momo also worsened his eyesight, and he's also shaved his stubble. His attire has also shifted back to what he wore during his gang-leader years.

Personality

Unji is an extremely kind, generous and compassionate individual who puts others before himself, as exemplified by his noble act of helping and looking after troubled teenagers. Such kindness earned him great respect and loyalty among the group of troubled teens who were willing to do whatever it took to get him out of Danmara. He is also chivalrous when around females. Before he and Momo took on the second stage of Danmara, Unji gave her his pants to avoid worrying about her skirt while maneuvering through the obstacle course and insisted that she continue to wear them even after they completed the stage. His good nature becomes even more apparent when using his yokai powers that has the effect of changing the user's personality. Though he normally wears an impassive expression on his face, he is shown displaying a normal range of emotions.

He is noted to have moments of being simple-minded. Hearing Unji noticing how hard it was for him to keep balance in the second stage, Momo made him realize that it was due to the fact that he is wearing geta sandals. By the end, the latter couldn't believe it when Unji accidently lost his geta sandals. He also possesses great confidence in his own capabilities after acquiring yokai powers, having once stated to his peers that he will effortlessly conquer the world of Danmara.

His preference for footwear is geta sandals, finding them to be cool.
Background

Futa's accident
Unji finds about his brother's death.
Unji was raised in a poor family alongside his younger brother, Futa. After their father's death, Unji stood by his younger brother Futa, shielding him from bullies and adversity as their mother struggled to support them alone. When Futa didn't come home one rainy day, Unji went looking for him, only to learn the heartbreaking news of Futa's drowning in a river. In the wake of Futa's mourning period, Unji's mother took him to an amusement park for a day of fun. However, the day turned grim when she tried to commit murder-suicide by having them both jump towards an oncoming train. Not wanting to die alongside her, Unji tries loosening his mother's hold and manages to free himself, resulting in him tragically witnessing his mother committing suicide alone.

Unji saves Bega and the boy
Unji using Umbrella Boy's powers to save Bega and a child from drowning.
After the loss of his family, Unji harbored a deep-seated disdain for the world that had brought him nothing but misfortune. Left orphaned, Unji was placed in a foster home but eventually ran away after defending himself against a few foster children who were bullying him. During his adolescence, Unji evolved into a troublesome gang leader with an agenda focused on instigating conflict. Following an incident where he directed his gang to attack the police, Unji was apprehended by officer Bega and placed in juvenile detention. Following his release, Unji was taken into Bega's custody and repeatedly attempted to exact revenge for his arrest, but failed each time he tried to strike him with an umbrella. Although he had the chance to attack Bega while he was asleep in his room, Unji decided against it upon seeing the officer sleeping next to a photograph of him, his wife, and daughter. Unable to accept Bega, even after learning about the loss of his family and his pledge to protect him, Unji walked outside in the rain to visit the site of Futa's accident. There, he witnessed a boy being harassed by a group of children and showed concern when the boy tried to retrieve his lunch bag from the river into which the bullies had tossed it. Upon Bega's sudden arrival to jump into the river to rescue the drowning boy, Unji promptly made an effort to reach them before it became too late. This led him to encounter Umbrella Boy who offered to share his powers to with him. Using Umbrella Boy's umbrellas to propel himself towards Bega and the boy, Unji managed to pull them out of the river and became relieved to see the officer breathing.

The following day, Unji went to the family grave alongside Bega and expressed with great regret for being alive instead of Futa, believing that his younger brother's constant happiness in his mother's presence could have sustained her will to live. Despite how he felt, Bega told Unji that he must live no matter what.

While seldom attending Renjaku High School, Unji dedicated his time assisting peers who have challenging backgrounds and established a building as a sanctuary for them to convene. This then led to the teenagers becoming his loyal followers as gratitude. Eventually, Unji encountered an old man who was released from a diorama. Unji permitted him to reside at his place and later took possession of the diorama, prompting him to investigate cursed artifacts in a library to understand the diorama better. It was there that a mysterious man persuaded him to undertake the mission of venturing into the cursed trunk's inner world to destroy it. He was then led by the man to a police box to receive Okarun's second kintama, being informed that it could help him to access his powers. After his gang informed him that a young girl, one of his followers, had entered the diorama, Unji commanded them not to follow her in, reserving the next entry for himself to fulfill his mission. Upon entering, Unji located the girl and took her place inside the diorama after their encounter led to her release. While unclear as to how the inner world supposedly operates, Unji commenced his plan to destroy it by eradicating all the monsters that dwelled within.
Abilities and Powers

Supernatural Abilities

Umbrella Boy Form [v · e]
Unji possesses powers of the yokai Umbrella Boy. Much like the yokai powers of Okarun and Aira, Unji's activation of his yokai power manifests as a mask and slightly alters his personality; in Unji's case, the young man acts more noble-minded towards his allies than usually. Unaware that his powers are sourced from a yokai, Unji refers to it as his spiritual power.

The mask covers up most of his face, leaving only his left eye and a portion of his forehead exposed, and has a dark menacing appearance; having spiked teeth, a spiked chin, and an octant right eye. Similar to Okarun's Turbo Granny appearance, Unji gains two thick vertical stripes across his eyes, which change to become a different color, has his hair turn white and nails turn black.

After falling under the possession of the Fairy-Tale Card, Unji was forced to assume a transformation that allowed the yokai to fully unleash the powers of Umbrella Boy. In this transformation, Unji takes on an appearance that mirrors Umbrella Boy. His head is taken up by a dark helmet-like head of Umbrella Boy's face, which is the complete version of the mask that manifests on his face when using the yokai's power, that extends all the way down to his collarbone. The helmet has a target at the center, reminiscent of Umbrella Boy's singular large eye, flanked by horizontal lines extending from the target's second circle to the spiked chin. It also boasts a broad, gaping mouth with spiked teeth, occasionally revealing Unji's own mouth inside. Umbrella Boy has Unji balance off of one leg, reminiscent of its single leg as a yokai.

Unji's Umbrella Boy form.
Unji in his full power Umbrella Boy form.
Enhanced Strength
Unji's Umbrella Boy powers gives him an increase in strength. During the Castle Siege stage in Danmara, Unji was able to knock down a group of archers with a single kick and could throw his umbrella with enough force to break through another group.
Enhanced Speed
Unji's gains an increase in speed, as he was fast enough to arrive on time to quickly move Momo out of the way of the Dark Knight's sword slash.
Parasol Materialization
Unji's Umbrellas
Unji is able to wield Umbrella Boy's umbrellas (specifically oil-paper umbrellas) that automatically constructs when accessing his power. He is limited to two umbrellas.
Strengths and Weaknesses
Unji attacking with his umbrella
The main strength of the umbrellas is that they are capable of firing off shockwaves that can destroy anything in its path when the umbrella opens via the switch on the handle. Additionally, the generated shockwaves from the umbrellas offer propulsive force to enable Unji to soar through the sky and traverse vast distances.

Unji is limited to only the two umbrellas materialized, and once opened, they will disappear and can't be re-summoned. Once both umbrellas have been opened, Unji will be depleted of Umbrella Boy's power and will need time until it is fully charged. However, this weakness did not seem to be present at the time of his first usage of Umbrella Boy's power, as Unji was able to open his umbrellas more than two times to propel himself and rescue Bega and a child from the river.
Full Power
Full Power Umbrella Boy Limitless Shockwave Generation
In his full power form, Unji has access to only one umbrella, as opposed to the two in his initial state, but gains the capability to unleash multiple rounds of shockwave blasts from his umbrella without carrying the repercussions of reverting back to his normal state. This allows him to attack his opponents continuously. Moreover, Unji achieves a kind of pseudo-flight by repeatedly propelling himself with shockwaves while airborne, which exceeds the capabilities of his initial rocket-like launch that limits him to a single propulsion per umbrella.
Usage
Unji utilizes his umbrellas as melee weapons. In close combat, Unji thrusts his umbrellas at his opponent, much like a lance, and opens them to release the shockwaves as a destructive attack. He can also use the umbrellas as throwing weapons to attack from a distance, with his enhanced strength being able to generate enough force behind his umbrella to penetrate and knock back a good portion of soldiers in an army. If in mid-air, Unji can choose to open his umbrellas to float and land safely on the ground.

While allied with Momo in Danmara, Unji used one of his umbrellas for the standard purpose of covering them from the rain.

Suiko (水虎, water tiger) is a legendary creature originating from China but which is present in Japanese folklore. They are a kappa-like yokai that lives in and around the Chikugo River (Kyushu), Lake Biwa (Shiga prefecture), and other bodies of water across Japan. However, the suiko is a different beast altogether and must not be confused with the kappa.

The Ta Koshin Jo Kur was a Kur of the Advance Unit who wielded the Ta Koshin Jo.

In Dandadan, he serves as a supporting antagonist during the Space Globalists Arc.

Appearance

The Kur has never been seen outside of his Ta Koshin Jo exosuit. Nonetheless, being a Kur, he is presumed to share the octopus-like physiology characteristic of his species.
Background

The Ta Koshin Jo Kur took part in the invasion of Sumer and he decimated with many other Kurs the last sumerian regiment after they provided a fake rendezvous point for the native people to reunite. The only survivors of the ambush were Bamora, Banga, Tome and Aja.
Synopsis

Kintama Hunt Saga

Space Globalists Arc

After the Advance Unit arrived on Earth in search of Bamora, the team commenced an attack on the Serpos and subsequently engaged Okarun, Aira, Jiji, and Momo. Following his confrontation with Okarun, the Ta Kashin Jo Kur's firearms are obliterated by the yokai power user. Subsequently, the team departs with Okarun's kintama, intending to energize their warp gate and call forth their primary fleet for an impending invasion.

Following the Family's intervention to stop the Advance Unit from calling their fleet, the Ta Koshin Jo Kur and the Jet Booster Exosuit Kur block Momo and Rokuro's path forward to seal the warp gate, with the former barraging them with a hail of bullets. The Ta Koshin Jo Kur is then hit with a surprise attack from Bamora, who utilizes her exosuit's gigantification and invisibility features, and is ultimately defeated when its exosuit explodes following the Sumerian's subsequent attacks.

He briefly appears during the Invasion of Sumer along with Takanoka Ru Patcho Kur and Ta Komeshi Kur as they decimate the last Sumerian battalion after they lured them into an empty field to meet up with other Sumerian soldiers. The ambush completely wipes out the native species' forces, leaving Bamora, Banga, Tome and Aja as the sole survivors.

Equipment

Ta Koshin Jo [v · e]
Ta Koshin Jo
The Kur wields the Ta Koshin Jo, a superheavy weight exosuit that is in the form of a large mecha with rocket launchers on its sides
Capabilities
Heavy Weaponry
Rocket Launchers.
Gatling guns.
The Ta Koshin Jo is able to be equipped with heavy weighted weaponry for combat, such as multiple rocket launchers and gatling guns.
Usage
As with all members of his race, the Kur uses the Ta Koshin Jo for the main purpose of surviving in the atmosphere of foreign planets and to engage in combat. In battle, the Kur uses his exosuit's heavy weaponry to overwhelm his opponents with a barrage of rockets and bullets.

The Ta Kowasa Kur was a Kur of the Advance Unit who wielded the Ta Kowasa.

In Dandadan, he serves as a major antagonist during the Space Globalists Arc.

Appearance

Ta Kowasa Kur can be considered a "normal" member of the Kur race, as his appearance is similar to that of an octopus, with a set of tentacles instead of a mouth. His size is medium in comparison to other members of his species, which are larger.

Ta Kowasa Exosuit
Ta Kowasa Exosuit
Personality

During the Kur Invasion, Ta Kowasa Kur proved to be an agile and quite strong member of the Advance Unit. When attempting to extract Jiji's energy, he thought he could drain him of all his energy and turn him into an empty shell. However, by becoming overconfident, he failed to realize it was too much energy, and due to his arrogance, his suit ended up exploding from overheating.

Ta Kowasa Explodes
Ta Kowasa Explodes
Background

During the invasion of Sumer, the Ta Kowasa Kur is found retrieving the exosuits crafted by the Big Mama to export them. When the rescue attempt of the Sumerian men fails, he's seen approaching Bamora while holding a screaming and struggling Aja in his mechanical arms. Banga, now wearing the God of Sumer exosuit, whips her tail towards the Ta Kowasa Kur, getting Aja out of the Kur's grasp. Thanks to Banga's speech, all the men rush towards the aliens and overwhelm them. The Ta Kowasa Kur gets covered by a lot of males, chipping him with rocks and punches. Right after Bamora escapes to Idea by using the Warp Gate, he, along with some members of the Advance Unit, catch Banga near the Sumerian tablet and begin torturing Aja to have her activate the inner mechanism of the Pyramid.

Despite Reiko Kashima's annihilating the main Kur fleet, his death was never confirmed.
Synopsis

Space Globalists Arc

After the Advance Unit arrived on Earth in search of Bamora, the team commenced an attack on the Serpos and subsequently engaged Okarun, Aira, Jiji, and Momo. Okarun weaves through the multitude of the Ta Kowasa Kur's attacks and lands a powerful kick which sends him rolling down the fields. With the Kintama obtained, he grabs the defeated target and asks Hastur Kur what do with him, to which he replies to collect him and investigate his internal anatomy. Mr. Mantis Shrimp delivers a powerful blow which cuts the Ta Kowasa's mechanical arm and frees Okarun. The team departs with Okarun's kintama, intending to energize their warp gate and call forth their primary fleet for an impending invasion..

At the start of the Kur Invasion, Mr. Mantis Shrimp throws a jab at him which he's able to block with his mechanical arms. The Dover Demon rushes towards the Mantis Exosuit Kur and takes this opportunity to restrain him, giving the Suda Ko Kur an easy shot. Before this could happen, his arms get pulled to the side by Aira's Acrobatic Silky Hair, saving Peeny Weeny and delivering a strong kick which sends the Ta Kowasa Kur crashing into a building, though this barely scratches him.

He tries to immobilize Aira but she splits her hair to get a superior number of arms and traps him inside a cocoon. She approaches him to deal the final blow but she's captured by the Ta Komeshi Kur's six cylindrical limbs and immediately activates his shockwave field, hurting her enough to make her lose her grip thus freeing his ally.

Immediately after Jiji deploys his Evil Gun on the Ta Komeshi Kur to save Aira, the Ta Kowasa Kur notices his spike in power and takes hold of him, planting his fingers in his chest and declaring he's going to absorb all of his dangerous energy until he's an empty husk. Suddenly, his exosuit chips and lots of blood spill out due to the massive quantity of energy being sucked from the Evil Eye. He tries to extract his fingers but they are stuck, so Jiji reveals he has been refining his Chi and expels it voluntarily, overheating the exosuit and causing it to implode. Slowly, the Ta Kowasa Kur is seen exiting the broken down Ta Kowasa.

Equipment

Ta Kowasa
Ta Kowasa's arms
The Ta Kowasa features six mechanical arms attached to the exosuit's back that the wearer can control, with their length being 3 meters long.
Strengths and Weaknesses
Ta Kowasa restrains Aira
The major strength of the mechanical arms is that they allow the wearer to bind the wearer's targets by grabbing their limbs, which leaves them opened for attacks. The claws of these arms are also strong enough to cause great pain, as Aja gave a look of agony from having her head squeezed by one of them. For defensive purposes, the wearer can put the arms in front of them to block incoming attacks.

As demonstrated by Aira using her Acrobatic Silky hair, an opponent can prevent themselves from being subdued by restraining each arm. Also, the arms are left vulnerable to attacks as long as the wearer keeps them extended to bind their opponent.
Absorption
Ta Kowasa's Absorption
The Ta Kowasa has the ability to absorb the energy from living beings through its fingers once inserted into their body.
Strengths and Weaknesses
The major strength of this ability is that the wearer can rob their opponent of their energy until they are nothing more than an empty husk. It is unknown if the stolen energy can be used by the Ta Kowasa wearer afterwards.

A major weakness to this ability is that there is a limit as to how much energy the exosuit can absorb. If the wearer continues to absorb energy from a living being who possesses massive reserves, the Ta Kowasa will end up overheating until it explodes. The absorption is automatic once the fingers are inserted into the body and cannot be deactivated by the wearer until the hands are released. The victim can exploit this weakness by physically keeping them trap

Takeshi Murakami (村むら上かみ剛たけ史し, Murakami Takeshi?) is a teacher at Kami High who seeks to steal female student Momo Ayase's power, ordered by the Orchestrator, by blackmailing female students, one beingKouki Yukishiro who bestows upon her an ability via a white kozuka knife and directs her to confront his intended victim using the black kozuka knife.

In Dandadan, he serves as an overarching antagonist during the Kozuka Knives Arc.

Appearance

Murakami is an older man with short dark hair who wears a tracksuit. He is seen wearing a matching long-sleeve sweatshirt and pants when informing Momo and Okarun of Sanjome's agreement to become the History and Culture Research Club.
Personality

On the surface, Murakami is a man who is friendly towards his coworkers. However, his true personality is a manipulative individual, using the reprehensible tactic of extorting female students, such as Kouki Yukishiro, to force them to do his bidding. Along with this, he used mind games by sweet talking Kouki that her mission can benefit her as well. While acting as a high-ranking subordinate of the Orchestrator, he is very cautious about keeping his identity a secret, having communicated to Kouki inside a locker despite there being no one around at the time.
Synopsis

Kintama Hunt Saga

Onbusuman Arc

At the faculty office, Murakami becomes confused about where his seat is, not realizing that Sanjome is occupying it right in front of him. He turns to Adachi for an answer, only to hear from her confusion as well as to where his seat is as well. When Murakami finally notices Sanjome, he is convinced of his claim to the seat after Sanjome states his name, which leads Murakami to recognize him as the deputy head teacher. Later, after Momo. Okarun, Kinta, and Bamora decide to establish the History and Culture Research Club, Murakami introduces them to Sanjome as their faculty supervisor.

Current Saga

Kozuka Knives Arc

At some point, Murakami was persuaded by the Orchestrator to work under him, obtaining lots of money and steroids. He was given the Severed Head Dribblers power and worked until he was granted the possibility to acquire subordinates for his own, which he sought to do so by extorting female students through their social media accounts. Upon discovering a photograph of a half-naked young girl on social media and recognizing her as Kouki Yukishiro, Murakami confronted her and issued a threat to reveal her image unless she acquiesced to his demands to strip Momo's psychic power for him, assumingly ordered by the Orchestrator.[1] To accomplish this, Murakami gave Kouki one of his Asura knives and used one on her to grant her the Lord of the Flies power, although the newly achieved spiritual sensitivity allowed her to see the pygmies who always followed her around and assisted her, making her believe that was the power given to her through the kozuka.[2]

After Kouki's initial failure to steal Momo's power, Murakami, while inside a locker, clarifies Kouki's mistake in wielding the knife, explaining that it necessitates the victim's submission before they can be stabbed. He then proceeds to tempt Kouki into giving into the power he gave her in order to become the type of person she desires.[3]

In the faculty office, Murakami inquires with Sanjome about Adachi's whereabouts. When Sanjome questions the reason for his inquiry, Murakami shares that he and a few colleagues intend to go to a singles mixer and invites Sanjome to accompany them. Intrigued by the idea, Sanjome consents to join. Later, Murakami sees Adachi seemingly coming back to the school and asks if she had been somewhere. Adachi responds that she had temporarily left to look after her sick mother. After offering his sympathies, Murakami invites her to a singles mixer with the staff. Adachi politely refuses the invitation and walks away, while he continues to encourage her to join.

After school, Murakami meets Kouki at the gym, where he notices Rin watching them from a distance. He then subjects the two female students to the Severed Head Dribblers of the Kami High gym before moving elsewhere. After Aira arrives with Okarun and Kinta to save Rin and Kouki, Murakami observes the conflict going on from an exercise bike in his apartment. He steps off to drink a beer and approaches Adachi who he hired to wear an erotic bunny outfit for him. He threatens to not pay her anymore because of the underwhelming performance and he knows that she will accept since she has to take care of her old mother. He returns to his bike while Adachi holds a talisman behind her back. Later, Murakami carries Adachi to the couch and she secretly summons the Jiangshi behind him, willing to buy as much time as possible for when he drops his guard, when suddenly a fly distracts Murakami and he turns around, seeing both the Jiangshi and a wave of bugs. The bugs are actually controlled by Kouki inside the school gym, revealing that her power is not the control of the pygmies, but the control of small creatures given by the Lord of the Flies yokai. The insects dive onto Murakami who begins writhing in pain and Adachi uses this opportunity to pull out her kozuka and asks him to admit defeat if he wants to live. He assumes that these were her powers and despite initially refusing, he grabs the tip of the knife and yields, cutting his palm.

Adachi succesfully acquires the Severed Head Dribblers power, causing the creatures attacking the girls in the gym to disappear. Murakami begs for help and she and the jiangshi jump in to clear the horde of bugs when he's suddenly lifted into the air and sent flying through the window, carrying him to the gym. The insects break through the building and they leave a powerless Murakami on the floor, who upon realizing what is happening, begins to act clueless and tries to leave. Aira sends him flying and he drops the act, declaring that he's going on to delete Kouki's erotic pictures, although he arrogantly tries to get the advantage since he still has them. Aira corrects him again with another kick as they only want to hear him admit he's a horrible person. The Orchestrator soon receives news on what happened and when Adachi tries to deposit Murakami's power, he disqualifies her since she didn't listen to his orders and Kouki defeated him by herself, so his subordinate attacks her but she's thankfully rescued by the policeman Bega.

Equipment

Asura
(阿修螺, Ashura?) [v · e]
Murakami was in possession of an Asura kozuka knife that possessed the power to visibly see the minuscule pygmy creatures.
Asura (Knife)
Capabilities
Power Absorption and Bestowal
Like its parent, the Asuras are capable of extracting powers from individuals, under the condition that the wielder's target admits defeat before being cut, and bestow the power onto themselves or someone else by cutting themselves.
Usage
Murakami used the Asura on Kouki to grant her the power to see the pygmies for her mission to steal Momo's psychic powers using the same knife.

The Takonoka Ru Patcho Kur was a Kur of the Advance Unit who wielded the Takonoka Ru Patcho.

In Dandadan, he serves as a major antagonist during the Space Globalists Arc.

Appearance

The Takonoka Ru Patcho Kur can be considered a "normal" member of the Kur race, as his appearance is similar to that of an octopus, with a set of tentacles instead of a mouth. His size is larger in comparison to other members of his species, who are smaller.

Takonoka Ru Patcho Kur (True Form)
Takonoka Ru Patcho Kur (True Form)
Personality

The extraordinary offensive and defensive capabilities of his exosuit cause him to get reckless while fighting. He considers humans to be sickening organisms which should be minced and burnt to a crisp. Like the rest of his species, he has a huge sense of superiority.
Background

He appears during the invasion of Sumer and partecipates in a giant ambush against the last Sumerian battalion, decimating their forces. Later he's seen guarding the hundreds of Sumerian men who are being fed to Big Mama in front of the pyramid. Bamora, Banga, Tome and Aja try to free them but the rescue attempt fails due to their lack of cooperation. They decide to make a run for the pyramid but the Takonoka Ro Patcho Kur deploys his guided missiles against Bamora, who gets saved by Banga, although receiving major injuries. She gets left behind despite Bamora's cries but the multiple explosions make her spot the Kaiju Exosuit.

Banga gets inside and saves Bamora from the Big Mama, landing a powerful punch. She then incites the Sumerian men to take back their planet which has been stolen by the aliens, leading to a gigantic revolt. The Takonoka Ru Patcho Kur gets covered and assaulted by multiple men, but he's able to escape.
Synopsis

Space Globalists Arc

While Jiji and Aira walk together back home, they are suddenly transported in Empty Space and are approached by the Takonoka Ru Patcho Kur together with the Suda Ko Kur and the Ta Komeshi Kur. They overwhelm the power users, even when Jiji transforms into Evil Eye, who refuses to fight due to the promise he made to Takakura. He unseals his exosuit and steps out, stating how the high moisture of the atmosphere interferes with their laser beams, and the high gravity causing the humans to have really tough bodies. Aira suddenly envelops hreself and Evil Eye into an hair sphere, giving them time to escape. The Takonoka Ru Patcho Kur quickly crawls back to his exosuit and he's reminded by the Suda Ko Kur that they'll be able to see them by using their life-sign detection HUD although it's unfortunately cluttered by mysterious orbs present only on Earth..

At the start of the Kur Invasion, he launches out a barrage which blows up the Ayase Residence Car and begins the fight. Jiji defeats the Ta Kowasa Kur, unable to absorb the huge amount of energy coming from the Evil Eye. The Takonoka Ru Patcho Kur along with his unit attempts to stop Jiji, shocked by his power which he had been hiding all this time. Through the smoke Aira suddenly appears and he quickly deploys his electric shield, explaining how his exosuit provides perfect offense and defense, rendering him unbeatable. She explains how the recent lack of hair maintenance caused her hair to get completely dry, which she uses to create a way through the shield and strike him since dry hair is not conductive.

The Takonoka Ro Patcho Kur electrocutes Aira while she's defenseless on the ground, claiming that she won't be able to escape again as they can now fight for more than three minutes thanks to the upgrades to their base. In spite of the various kicks, he proclaims how not even explosions can crack his armor, making her efforts pointless. Okarun finally enters Empty Space and contacts Jiji and Aira to tell them about the power of the spiral. She manages to spin her hair faster and faster, turning into a drill which finally chips the Takonoka Ru Patcho. By combining this with the power of words, she shouts the name of her special move: "Pirouette, Noble Drill" and pierces through the Takonoka Ru Patcho, eliminating the Kur inside.

Taro is an anatomical model who's right-side makes up his exposed muscle while his left compromises of his skin half. On his skin half, he is given a shaved haircut.

Personality

Taro has shown to be greatly in love with Hana to the point where he reassembled himself in a matter of seconds just to see her again. When Hana told him to go back otherwise he'd become trash like her, he said he didn't care and that if he didn't stay now that'd he'd regret it for the rest of his life.
ADVERTISEMENT

Background

Synopsis

Kintama Hunt Saga

Cursed House Arc

After finding out Hana's location, Taro rushes out of the school to reunite with her but ends up attracting the attention of Momo, Okarun, and Jiji, with the girl using her powers to try and stop him in order to retrieve the Christmas ornament hanging from his crotch, believing it to be Okarun's missing kintama. Refusing to stop for them, Taro tries to shake them off his tail and manages to do so after dissembling himself from Momo's psychic grip. However, Taro ends up losing his heart to Momo, resulting in him crying out in pain as the latter begins striking it as way to track him down. After being found by Momo, Okarun, and Jiji, Taro hears Hana's voice underneath the garbage and runs up to dig her out, only for Hana to ask that he leave her since she has already accepted her fate. Taro refuses to comply as he genuinely states his love to her, which moves her.

After Momo offers her help by taking in Hana as a boarder at her house, Taro agrees to return to the school in exchange for meeting Hana during nights. Later at night, as he rushes over to the Ayase residence to meet Hana, Taro ends up running into a few school kids who become frightened by his sudden appearance and gets hit by a truck along the way, causing him to be late in his meeting with Hana.

Along with the Dover Demon and Chiquitita, Taro assists Seiko in fighting the Evil Eye, who has possessed Jiji, by sealing the yokai inside of him with talismans. Shortly after, Taro is thanked by Seiko for his assistance but the anatomical model wonders what he should do with his organs that he had to remove in order to make himself hollow, to which Seiko tells him to put in a grocery bag.

At the Ayase residence, Taro keeps the Evil Eye sealed inside him as Momo, Seiko, and Manjiro try to exorcise it out from Jiji's body. However, with the plan failing, Taro and the other invited guests join the Ayases for dinner. After eating the oden served, Taro unexpectedly causes the Evil Eye to release his hold on Jiji, after the young man reacts to the hot dish Taro put in his mouth, and helps Seiko to realize that Jiji can only be return to normal if he comes into contact with anything hot, while the Evil Eye can be released if he comes into contact with anything cold. Taro then asks Seiko as to how long he will loan out his body to Jiji since the situation he is in is interfering with his alone time with Hana. Seiko tells Taro that his frequent meetings with Hana will be put on hold and that she has set a ten o'clock curfew for them, much to his displeasure.

The next day, Taro is forced to accompany Jiji to the hospital to visit his parents and becomes annoyed with his compliments, such as putting his clothes on wrong or not moving as he likes. After making it to the hospital, Taro tries moving his body to be in tone with the moment of Jiji reuniting with his recovered parents, as suggested by Momo and Okarun, but ends up doing a bad job of it.

Evil Eye Arc

After the barrier from the talismans had been used up, Taro is given permission from Seiko to release himself from Jiji, much to his relief to finally relax his body.

ADVERTISEMENT
Abilities and Powers

Natural Abilities

Physical Prowess

Immense Speed: Taro possesses tremendous speed, so much so that he can match Okarun's enhanced speed in his Turbo Granny form and generate enough momentum to pull Momo while she was clinging onto him with her psychic hands.

Immense Stamina & Endurance: Taro was shown to possess enough stamina to maintain his top speed transversing from Kami High to a junkyard to rescue Hana.

Disassemble: In his capacity as an anatomical model, Taro is able to disassemble his body at will and subsequently reassemble it. This ability was advantageous in liberating himself from Momo's psychic hold. However, he was oblivious to the fact that during the process of disassembly, Momo had succeeded in seizing his heart, thereby rendering him vulnerable to her control, as she could inflict internal pain by targeting it. Additionally, it was beneficial in mitigating the effects of the Evil Eye controlling Jiji's body, as Taro enveloped Jiji's body with his own while having Seiko's sealing talismans attached to various parts of himself. This approach, however, required Taro to temporarily relinquish his organs and exert effort in keeping himself attached to Jiji, resulting in him being completely exhausted by the time the talismans had worn off.

Urban Legend

A common school mystery is of the Anatomical Model that comes to life at night. The model is usually found within the science laboratory, where its eyes will follow the person.
Etymology

The name Taro means "thick, big, great" (太) (ta) and "son" (郎) (ro).
It's also an incredibly generic male name in Japanese, with Yamada Taro being the Japanese equivalent of John Doe.
